fields.dirty: true = the image must be retaken. Set to false after the new image is checked and copied into the manual
fields.used: false = the image file is not referenced by any tex file
fields.used_in: tex file and line of each \includegraphics
fields.category: main_window, flight_deck, view, dialog, menu, report, composite, annotated, external
fields.automation: tested = steps run in the runner, easy / medium / hard = estimate, manual = taken by hand
fields.database: key in databases, null = no database open
fields.requires: data and state needed before the capture (reconstruction, evaluation, view point, files)
fields.filters: filter settings before loading, null = no filter active
fields.flight_deck: false = Flight Deck collapsed before the capture, so the view gets the full width
fields.frame: true = the tex file draws a frame around the image
fields.steps: runner steps: runtime commands, sleep <ms>, wait <obj>, dump <cmd>, grab <obj> [suffix] (QWidget::grab), shot <obj>[+<obj>...] (Xvfb screen cropped to the widget or the union of several widgets, needed for OpenGL)
fields.recipe_hint: how the image could be automated, not yet tested
fields.volatile: content that can change between runs
fields.fresh: true = the database is opened again before the capture, so no data is loaded
